cd /app && python3 << 'EOF'
from PIL import Image
import sys

try:
    img = Image.open('code.png')
    print(f"Image size: {img.size}")
    print(f"Image mode: {img.mode}")
    img.show() if False else None  # Don't display
    # Try to extract text using OCR
    try:
        import pytesseract
        text = pytesseract.image_to_string(img)
        print("\nExtracted text:")
        print(text)
    except ImportError:
        print("pytesseract not available, trying alternative...")
        # Save to a temporary location and try another method
        img.save('/tmp/code_copy.png')
        print("Image saved to /tmp/code_copy.png")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Error: {e}")
    sys.exit(1)
EOF
